SpcxcSwapExecutor.processWeth(uint256,uint256) (src/SpcxcSwapExecutor.sol#112-131) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- require(bool,string)(weth.balanceOf(address(this)) == balance - amount,incorrect input spent) (src/SpcxcSwapExecutor.sol#129)
assessment: reviewed; no exploitable path established under documented dependencies
reason: Equality is an explicit atomic conservation postcondition: supported WETH must spend exactly amount, and harvesting must preserve LP shares. description:
Reentrancy in DickbuttRewardsDistributor.distributeBatch(uint256,address[],uint256[],bytes32[][]) (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#250-293):
	External calls:
	- this.executeTransfer(account,amount) (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#278-287)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- paid[roundId][account] = true (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#274)
	DickbuttRewardsDistributor.paid (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#72) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- DickbuttRewardsDistributor.paid (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#72)
	- paid[roundId][account] = false (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#285)
	DickbuttRewardsDistributor.paid (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#72) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- DickbuttRewardsDistributor.paid (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#72)
	- r.distributed += batchPaid (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#290)
	DickbuttRewardsDistributor.rounds (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#64) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- DickbuttRewardsDistributor.activateRound(uint256) (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#208-218)
	- DickbuttRewardsDistributor.cancelPendingRound(uint256) (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#194-201)
	- DickbuttRewardsDistributor.closeRound(uint256) (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#224-238)
	- DickbuttRewardsDistributor.roundInfo(uint256) (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#401-408)
	- DickbuttRewardsDistributor.rounds (src/DickbuttRewardsDistributor.sol#64)
assessment: reviewed; no exploitable path established under documented dependencies
reason: Batch is keeper-gated and nonReentrant; paid is set before each external self-call and reset only if its atomic transfer fails. executeTransfer accepts only self. Aggregate reserves/distributed update after the loop. Callback tests attempt close/propose/reentry/direct transfer; reserve invariants include partial payment and cancellation. Privileged malicious token/admin combinations are outside supported token assumptions and can cause rollback/DoS.
